title: A Garden for the Kitchen
author: Odile Hartwell
blurb: Sebastian Joubert, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
